title: Wayfare Pass Trip Benefits — Training Notes
content:
# Trip benefits of a Wayfare Pass membership — training notes

**When does a Wayfare Pass (rider membership) confer trip benefits?**
A membership confers its trip benefits only while it is in trial, active or pending cancellation status: the member discount (the plan's member discount percent on the plan's discount ride options), free cancellations (the plan's free cancellations per month), rebook grace (the plan's rebook grace in minutes), Priority Pickup waivers (the plan's Priority Pickup waivers per month), the reservation fee waiver (where the plan waives reservation fees) and ride credit earning. Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares) applies them when it charges each trip and records each use on the trip's charges.

**How are the monthly allowances counted?**
Allowances count per calendar month in the member's home market time, unused allowances do not carry over, and a benefit is used only on a trip requested while the membership was in force.

**What if several benefits touch one trip?**
They all apply: the member discount first, then ride credit is earned on the discounted fare, and credit spent pays the discounted fare.

## Status table

The rule is a complete list ("only"), so every status has an answer.

| Membership status | Trip benefits conferred? |
|---|---|
| trial, active, pending cancellation | yes |
| enrolled, past due, paused, cancelled | no |

## Worked illustration (hypothetical inputs)

A Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly member in active status takes a Wayfare Comfort trip whose fare excluding the booking fee is 40.00. The 5 percent member discount comes first, 2.00, leaving a discounted fare of 38.00. Ride credit is then earned on the discounted fare, and any credit the member spends on the trip pays the discounted fare.

A free cancellation not used in March does not carry into April; April starts with the plan's full allowance.
